isolation_forest.objective: Silhouette between top-5%-by-score group and rest (1,000-row subsample of train), maximize
isolation_forest.verdict: Exhaustive grid (60 combos, 40.8s) found silhouette=0.4154. Optuna/TPE reached 0.4107 in only 30 trials (25.0s) -- 0.0047 silhouette below the grid optimum, i.e. Optuna did not find quite as good a config within the same trial budget on this particular (small, cheap-to-grid-search) space, reported honestly rather than rounded up. Random search reached 0.3840 in the same 30-trial budget -- Optuna outperformed random search (+0.0267 silhouette difference).

phase8_grid_reference.note: Phase 8 (v2)'s Model 8 grid used reg_covar=1e-5 fixed and did not search it -- Optuna additionally tunes reg_covar, so a BIC improvement from that alone is expected, not necessarily evidence Optuna 'found a better n_components/covariance_type'.

gmm.verdict: Optuna's best BIC (-47044.7) vs. Phase 8 (v2)'s fixed-reg_covar grid best (-27620.9): an improvement of 19423.8.

vae.objective: Validation-split reconstruction MSE (minimize), 60-epoch search budget per trial (vs. 200 epochs for the deployed Model 10 artifact -- reduced budget for tractability across 20 trials)
vae.verdict: Best config found by the search (60-epoch budget): {'latent_dim': 3, 'hidden1': 8, 'beta': 0.011321360823372508, 'lr': 0.0031245564451575785}, val MSE 0.2757. The deployed Model 10 (latent_dim=3, hidden1=8, beta=0.1, 200 epochs) reaches val MSE 0.3458 -- these numbers are not directly comparable (different epoch budgets), so this is reported as 'what the search found under a search-appropriate budget'.
